text:
maria: Heads-up — we need an urgent quota bump in ap-northeast-1 to provision the new Dedicated GPU pool next week. Current blockers are Elastic IPs per region and ENI per-subnet limits.

maria: Target capacity: 120 GPU instances across 3 AZs (approx 40 instances/AZ). That maps to roughly 120 primary EIPs + ~60 spare for canaries/bastions. Current account limits show: EIP quota = 60, ENI per subnet = 32. Not enough.

ken: What numbers should we request from cloud support? also need account & subnet ids.

maria: Requesting: EIP quota -> 300 (ap-northeast-1), ENI per subnet -> 128, VPC total ENI -> 1600, ephemeral public IP pool -> 200. Account: 123456789012. Subnets (AZ a/b/c): subnet-aaa111, subnet-bbb222, subnet-ccc333.

maria: Paste for support ticket: ```
Account: 123456789012
Region: ap-northeast-1
Requested increases:
  - Elastic IPs (VPC): 300 total
  - ENI per subnet: 128
  - VPC ENI soft limit: 1600
  - Public IPv4 pool / ephemeral IPs: 200
Justification: Launching a Dedicated GPU serving pool (prod) to support 3 customers with high-throughput inference. Needs predictable public-ip headroom for bastion/canaries/monitoring endpoints and to support cross-AZ failover. Timeline: provision week of 2026-04-06.
```

priya: Is IPv6 required here? Could we avoid so many EIPs by using IPv6 + NAT64 or private endpoints?

oliver: IPv6 would reduce public IPv4 consumption for service endpoints but our external customers expect IPv4 endpoints today. We should request the IPv4 increases and open a parallel "enable IPv6" ticket to reduce long-term headroom needs.

infra-bot: Ticket created with cloud provider: CASE-APN-984512. Support link: https://provider.support/cases/CASE-APN-984512 (auto-updates enabled).

cloud-ops: FYI — support will ask for traffic/connection justifications (concurrent connections, NAT throughput) and expected growth. Add a short table of peak concurrent connections per instance and expected autoscale headroom. Also request ENI quota per subnet rather than default to avoid AZ imbalance.

ken: I'll draft the justification. Quick ask: can we temporarily gate rollout to two AZs to reduce immediate quota needs?

maria: We can stage to 2 AZs (80 instances) as an interim mitigation but still want the increase to avoid repeated limit requests.

priya: For temporary mitigation we can also use a small fleet behind NAT gateways for non-customer-facing traffic (metrics, bootstrapping), and reuse EIPs for canaries. That reduces EIP need by ~30%.

oliver: Note: if support denies ENI-per-subnet increase, we can also spin up a separate VPC per AZ as fallback, but that complicates networking and costs. Try escalation first.

maria: Can someone (ken?) escalate with the SRE account team and attach the draft justification? We need approval by EOD Wednesday to meet provisioning timeline.

ken: On it. I'll post the draft here when ready. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up with cloud provider in 48h.
